title: Answer
description:
Leaders are remembered for the word of God they spoke and for the end of their conduct, not for a bare office.

Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever. Teachings change. He does not.

There is an altar from which those who serve the former tent have no right to eat. The eating that belonged to those priests is refused to anyone who remains at that tent.

The bodies whose blood was taken into the sanctuary were burned outside the camp. Jesus suffered outside the gate to sanctify the people with His own blood. Those who go to Him go outside as well.

Here there is no continuing city. The city to come is sought. The assembly is not thereby homeless in the world. It is a people aimed at that city.

When offerings for sin have ended, the sacrifice that remains is the sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that give thanks to His name.
